parsed.limitation: Checks actual source/new bytes and unchanged labels. Semantic perturbations are separately content-compared by the portable checker, not executed.
Signatures and selected pins only, not functional or cross-side acceptance.

parsed.consumer_rule: Each consumer independently declares all ordinary refs in its payload and Resource/evidence-ID closure.
parsed.dedup_rule: Per consumer after byte verification; active resource expansion and combined artifact DAG cycles reject.
limitations: Not a full JSON Schema validator, admission/authorization proof, or runtime/API implementation.
Only exact formal EvidenceRecord-ID fields are followed; arbitrary strings are not references.
No target reads, intent commits, fact commits, functional tests, network, or database actions.
Evidence records not consumed by any artifact are outside this consumer-closure audit.
